type: DEVIATION: EXP-003 S3 not executed (specification gap)
description: Protocol section 7 and EXP-003 section 5 define S3 as a reanalysis of EXP-001 raw outputs with (a) welfare from standardized raw utility and (b) unmatched value equal to the acceptability threshold's satisfaction. The EXP-001 raw outputs store per-run metrics only, not matchings or utilities, so S3 cannot be computed from them; it would need a deterministic re-simulation of the EXP-001 runs. It also needs choices the frozen text does not fix: how utility is standardized (as drawn, already unit variance, or per viewer), the value of an unmatched agent under (a), and how the threshold's satisfaction is defined under (b) given numpy's interpolated quantile.
action: not run; reported to the owner (G-FREEZE); no code written for S3
